svg.title: Exact Frobenius slope bounds and root automorphism growth

cc:Work.dc:title: Exact Frobenius slope bounds and root automorphism growth
cc:Work.dc:description: HN.52: Bq=(1/25)(1-101^(-q))+4*101^(-q), q=1..4; threshold 1/12 and limit 1/25. HN.49: genus 2, initial root degree 0, lower bound 2m-1, m=1..5; exact root subgroup dimension for m>=2.

g.text: Exact for this subgroup when m is at least 2.
Two exact bounds for bundle stability
Left: tensor-slope error. Right: root-subgroup automorphisms.
HN.52 and HN.49. Bounds are proved quantities; the whole automorphism group may be larger.
